findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: There was a phone observed to be stored on top of a lid to a bread container. CORRECTED- The PIC removed the phone and educated the employee. Phones hold a significant amount of bacteria and should never be stored on a food-contact surface. Ensure that employee items are stored separately to avoid contaminating food-contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: There is a bottle of Sushi Sauce that states to “Refrigerate After Opening” that is observed to be stored at room temperature in the dry storage area. The PIC was unsure of where the sauce is intended to be stored and will be looking at the trainings. The PIC stated that they will discard the sauce if it is required to be refrigerated. A follow up is scheduled for 5/29/2026 to ensure that the sauce has either been discarded or if it has been determined that the sauce is safe to be stored at room temperature.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored.
findings.comment: There were two knives observed to be stored with the blade between the side of the preparation cooler and the side of a preparation table. CORRECTED- Both knives were removed to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Proper utensil storage was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that utensils are stored on food-contact surfaces that are frequently cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12(C) In-Use Utensils, Between-Use Storage. During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored:(C) On a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food-contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency specified under §§ 4-602.11 and 4-702.11.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of repair: 

1. There is observed to be no sealing between the dish table and the wall to the right of the dish machine. Ensure that the table is sealed to the wall and is made to be smooth and easily cleanable. 
2. The metal plate under the walk-in cooler door is observed to be loose and is allowing water to pool under it. Ensure that this metal plate is re-sealed to the ground to prevent food debris and water from accumulating under it.

Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair. Ensure that all repairs are made to be smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The back left corner (to the right of the reach-in coolers) and the front right corner (under the front soda nozzle) of the floor in the bar area are observed to be in need of cleaning. This was shown to the PIC. Ensure that physical facilities are cleaned as often as necessary to maintain them clean.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
